intent_en: To illustrate the financial risk of relying on high returns from reported assets to cover the gap between those assets and actual liabilities.
previous_intent: To illustrate the financial shortfall between reported assets and actual liabilities, highlighting the reliance on high returns from risky investments to cover the substantial unfunded liability.
narration_support: profits from the risky investments will reduce the overall unfunded liability
chart_support: Infographic comparing Reported Assets and Actual Liabilities, showing a large Actual Unfunded Liability gap, with the asset path leading to a wheel of fortune symbolizing risk.
evidence_note: The narration discusses using profits from risky investments to reduce unfunded liability, while the chart visualizes the gap between Reported Assets ($3.6tr) and Actual Liabilities ($7.0tr), labeling the difference as Actual Unfunded Liability ($3.4tr) and associating the asset path with a wheel of chance.
